recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for HL7/fhir. If Bundle narrative generation remains defective in current tooling, address it in the current publisher/tooling repository or Maven dependency rather than in core specification source.
issue_request: FHIR-13102 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core and asked IGPublisher to produce non-empty XHTML narrative for Bundle examples, showing useful Bundle and entry/resource narrative content instead of a blank root page.
initial_application: SVN revision 11840, represented as git commit 6a3ce81fffda0cdacc45287ed272409b34cdca08, changed the then-tracked Java NarrativeGenerator, XhtmlNode, and IGPublisher Publisher code to add Bundle rendering and route Bundle example HTML through that renderer.
additional_context: The Java files touched by the original implementation are not tracked active source in the current checkout. The IGPublisher code was removed in 2019 with a commit explicitly saying it had gone to Maven, and the current build.gradle.kts uses org.hl7.fhir:kindling:1.25.5-SNAPSHOT and runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from that external dependency. A related later issue, FHIR-17401, covered document-specific Bundle presentation and was also characterized in Jira as old tooling work to raise in the external fhir-ig-publisher tracker if still needed.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current HL7/fhir source checkout does not own the active IGPublisher/NarrativeGenerator implementation for this behavior, so the correct reconciliation is an external-repo audit rather than a core source edit.
